title: Destiny Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when that mouthful of heart's blood dyed the bamboo slip crimson, Chen Ji saw—the eyes that had never opened, behind the Xuanwu Sect.

text.content: The night was deep over the city walls. Between the roof tiles, Chen Ji pinched the bamboo slip with two fingers. The bamboo was cool, the carved marks still fresh, and the old Chen family emblem glowed faintly blue in the moonlight—this was one of the hidden pieces he had planted three years ago, designated number forty-seven. Tonight, it had finally fulfilled its purpose.

dialogue.content: "Forty-seven has returned, the layout is three-tenths complete." The remnant soul's voice drifted from the first page, "But you must understand—the larger the chessboard, the more severe the backlash. Your current Heavenly Fate value..."

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the bamboo slip into his sleeve, the corner of his lips slightly raised. Three years. Su Qingyao's trust, the fractures within Xuanwu Sect, the hidden pieces of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path—all the pieces were moving toward their predetermined positions. And he only needed to place one more chess piece.

dialogue.content: "One hundred and three. Enough for you to activate the Destiny Chess Game once more, but after that..." The remnant soul's voice paused, "The forty-ninth piece has begun to show fluctuations, and its self-awareness is awakening."

text.content: Number forty-nine. Chen Ji silently recited this name in his heart. Han Lie, the number one prodigy of Xuanwu Sect, unmatched in brute strength yet simple-minded—such people were easiest to manipulate, and also most easily counterattacked. His awakening meant the chess game was beginning to slip from control.

choice.prompt: The forty-ninth piece fluctuates, and the Destiny Chess Game shows signs of backlash—Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.text: Accelerate the layout and trigger early detonation
choices.description: Before Han Lie fully awakens, use the 49th piece as the trigger to incite internal strife within Xuanwu Sect, and reap maximum benefits in the chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 Heavenly Fate points, Han Lie may escape
choices.visible_reward: Xuanwu Sect's high-level division, Tianqing Sect's pressure drastically reduced
choices.risk_hint: The layout is not yet complete, may be exposed by Han Lie

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolding in the depths of his consciousness. Forty-nine points of light were like a star map, and one of them was trembling violently—that was Han Lie's fate. He flicked his fingers, detonating that star ahead of schedule. In an instant, a muffled explosion came from the direction of Xuanwu Sect.

choices.text: Stabilize the chessboard and suppress the fluctuation
choices.description: Consume Heavenly Fate points to stabilize control over Han Lie, repressing the awakened consciousness, but this will delay the overall layout progress.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate points, Xuanwu Sect's offensive continues
choices.visible_reward: The completeness of the chess game improves, subsequent gains doubled
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate points continue to deplete, consequences of failed suppression are severe

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertips condensed mysterious runes, layering them one upon another over Han Lie's fate. The starlight gradually stabilized, but the forty-ninth point of light grew even more agitated—this was a caged beast being angered, and its counterattack was only a matter of time.

At the same moment, a thousand li away at the Xuanwu Sect Martial Arena. Han Lie was drenched in blood, his long halberd pointed at the void, his eyes crimson red like a beast. Deep in his consciousness, something was awakening—a voice not belonging to him whispered: "You are merely a chess piece, not a chess player."

dialogue.content: "Get out of my mind!" Han Lie roared, sweeping his halberd across and shattering a stone lion three zhang away, "Whatever you are, trying to manipulate me, Han Lie—dream on!"

text.content: His anger was not without reason. Thirty-seven consecutive victories, the number one prodigy of Xuanwu Sect, the position of next Sect Master promised by the Sect Master's own mouth—such a chosen son of heaven, how could he tolerate being someone else's puppet? But what he didn't know was that precisely these achievements made Chen Ji choose him.

And in another location, deep within ancient ruins, Chen Nian's tightly closed eyes suddenly opened. She felt a familiar aura—her brother Chen Ji's aura, mixed with thick blood and the struggle of destiny. The Key of Destiny and the Chess Player of Destiny resonated across a thousand li.

dialogue.content: "Brother..." Chen Nian murmured, her fingers tightly gripping the stone platform beneath her, "What are you doing? Why are you using such dangerous power..." Her voice was swallowed by the darkness of the ruins' depths, only those eyes, identical to Chen Ji's, flickering in the darkness.

choice.prompt: The resonance of destiny created an unexpected effect—Chen Nian's perception introduced a new variable into Chen Ji's chess game.

choices.text: Seize the momentum and expand the resonance
choices.description: Chen Nian's perception makes the foresight clearer; guide this power along its course to strengthen the layout against Xuanwu Sect.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian may expose her location
choices.visible_reward: Foresight accuracy improves by 200%, Xuanwu Sect's flaws fully revealed
choices.risk_hint: Holy Sect may trace the connection

text.content: Chen Ji followed the bloodline resonance, extending his consciousness into the depths of the ruins. Chen Nian's figure appeared faintly in the realm of prophecy—she was bound by countless chains, yet still desperately reaching her hand toward him. The Key of Destiny and the Chess Player of Destiny connected for the first time outside the chessboard.

choices.text: Sever by force and protect Chen Nian
choices.description: Immediately cut the resonance, not allowing Chen Nian to be exposed to danger, even if it means abandoning this excellent foresight opportunity.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian's safety is guaranteed, sibling bond deepens

text.content: Chen Ji ruthlessly severed that thread of resonance. Agonizing pain shot from his heart; before Chen Nian's figure dissolved from the realm of prophecy, he saw a tear slide down her cheek. "Brother, you did it again..." Her voice was like a sigh.

The moment the resonance broke, the forty-ninth piece's fluctuation violently intensified. Han Lie let out a long howl toward the sky, his eyes completely turned blood-red; his consciousness had broken through three seals—Chen Ji's suppression had developed a gap.

dialogue.content: "So that's how it is!" Han Lie's voice became low and dangerous, "That trash from Tianqing Sect... it was you, wasn't it? You've been manipulating me from behind the scenes all along!" He abruptly turned, his gaze piercing through countless obstacles, staring directly toward Tianqing Sect, "Chen Ji—I will personally snap your neck!"

text.content: The backlash had begun. Chen Ji felt as if an invisible hand was clutching his chest, a mouthful of blood rushing to his throat. He pressed his hand against his chest, crimson seeping between his fingers—this was the price of the Destiny Chess Game's backlash, the weight every chess player must bear.

dialogue.content: "The backlash is more severe than anticipated." The remnant soul's voice carried rare gravity, "His degree of awakening exceeded imagination, and... there is third-party power meddling. Someone is helping you, but also harming you."

text.content: Third party? Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his consciousness re-converging toward the realm of prophecy. He wanted to see clearly who was stirring this chess game—was it Ling Yuan? The Holy Sect? Or the Heavenly Will that had never shown itself?

choice.prompt: The backlash strikes, but more dangerous is the involvement of third-party forces—Chen Ji must decide how to respond.

choices.text: Push through the foresight and track the mastermind behind
choices.description: At the cost of Heavenly Fate points, forcefully activate complete foresight to trace the source of the third-party forces.
choices.visible_reward: Clearly see the true appearance of the mastermind behind, obtain crucial intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May see things that should not be seen

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, the Tianji Record Fragment wildly flipping. The realm of prophecy surged into his consciousness like a tide—behind layers of mist, he saw a pair of eyes. Those eyes had never opened, yet they were clearly watching him. Not Ling Yuan, not the Holy Sect, but an existence far more ancient and vast than all of this.

choices.description: Immediately close the gate of foresight, suppress the backlash, stabilize the current layout before making further plans.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate points, layout does not collapse

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully closed the door of foresight. The backlash receded like a tide, but that sensation of being watched lingered. He knew that behind the chessboard, a pair of eyes had been watching—watching him自以为是的布局，却不知自己也是更大的棋局中一枚棋子。

At the same time, in the Xuanwu Sect Council Hall. The Grand Elder and the Sect Master sat on opposite sides, a visible crack between them. Han Lie's declaration of awakening had just arrived, and the entire sect was in upheaval.

dialogue.content: The Grand Elder stroked his beard and coldly smiled: "Sect Master, this is the prodigy you personally fostered? He didn't even know he was being manipulated, and now that he's awakened, his first act is not to be grateful to the sect, but to seek revenge against someone? Hmph, if Tianqing Sect truly has such a person, I shall have to reassess this opponent."

text.content: The Sect Master's face was ashen. The chess piece he had painstakingly cultivated had been secretly manipulated by someone, and now it had become the laughingstock of the entire sect. What infuriated him even more was that this old fox of a Grand Elder was clearly using this incident to seize power. The internal cracks within Xuanwu Sect were being completely torn open by Han Lie's disturbance.

dialogue.content: ""Sect Master, setting aside the matter of Han Lie for now." The Grand Elder shifted topics, "Tianqing Sect has been making frequent moves recently; I hear that old Ling Yuan is secretly contacting forces of the Demonic Path. If this is true, the landscape of our three major sects may need to be reshuffled."

text.content: Chen Ji saw this through the Tianji Record, and a cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth. The rift between the Grand Elder and the Sect Master was deeper than he had anticipated—one of the fruits of his three-year layout. But the involvement of third-party forces made him feel, for the first time, the terror of a chess game slipping beyond control.

dialogue.content: "What did you see?" The remnant soul's voice was low and cautious, "An existence that could frighten every Chess Player throughout history..."

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer. He only quietly stared at those tightly closed eyes within the realm of prophecy, and a chilling possibility surfaced in his heart—if the Tianji Record itself were a larger chess game? If all his layouts were proceeding according to some higher will?

Just then, violent pain struck his chest again. Chen Ji doubled over, a mouthful of heart's blood spurted out, dying the bamboo slip on the ground crimson. The blood spread along the bamboo's grain, and gradually revealed a line of hidden text—a sentence that had never appeared in the Chen family's ancestral teachings: "Both chess pieces and chess players are within the eyes of Heavenly Way."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared at that line of blood text, his pupils contracting sharply. His voice was very soft, as if speaking to himself: "So that's how it is... I thought I was laying out the world, but from the beginning, I was the chosen chess piece." He raised his head, his eyes shining with light sharper than ever before, "But so what? A chess piece can also devour the chess player."

text.content: The night deepened, the lights of Tianqing Sect extinguished one by one. Only on the city walls, a blood-soaked youth stood alone in the wind, the bamboo slip in his hand stained with blood. His lips carried a smile, but his eyes held an unprecedented chill. The Destiny Chess Game had only just begun, and he had already decided to overturn the entire board.
